parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the door and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the frame, typically finished with paint or laminate.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close, providing access to the storage space.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and organizes stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
